sloka: भिद्यतेऽयं गिरिर्भूतैरिति मत्त्वा तपस्विनः ।त्रस्ता विद्याधरास्तस्मादुत्पेतुः स्त्रीगणैः सह॥५-१-२२॥
transliteration: bhidyate'yaṁ girirbhūtairiti mattvā tapasvinaḥ ।trastā vidyādharāstasmādutpetuḥ strīgaṇaiḥ saha॥5-1-22॥

translations.english: Even the ascetics left the place approaching that the mountain would be broken into pieces by creatures. The alarmed vidyadharas leaped into the sky along with groups of their women, leaving behind golden jugs of wine as well as precious utensils, big and small sizes, and golden goblets, cups in the drinking place, as well as many tasty eatables like licking food, chewing food and many types of meat. They also left bullhides and swords with golden sheaths.
translations.hindi: जब हनमानजी ने पर्वत को दबाया, तब उस पर्वत पर बसने वाले तपस्वी श्रौर विद्याधर लोग घबड़ा कर ग्रपनी श्रपनी स्त्रियों को साथ ले वहाँ से चल दिए
